title: 第十三章 初见恐怖伊万第十四章 狂想曲初现端倪
content_zh:
一众几人在邹家成的餐厅相谈甚欢，谈的反而不是关于悬崖酒店的话题，而是天南海北的趣事之类的，这个也是我平时喜欢的状态，酒逢知己的状态，但同时内心里却是有一个触点像是要被触发，这个触发点很奇怪，不仅仅是触发一次就可以启动了，貌似要连续两次触发才可以启动，可是这帮家伙谈论的话题就像只是一次触碰一次，然后又跑开了，等过一会儿有贱贱的过来，触碰了两次，然后又触碰一次，归零。
我心里的那个急呀！
怎么及不碰双数呢？像极了那个潇洒的seven特工手中的微型炸弹圆珠笔被敌人按了单数，就差那么一下按下去触发了，好是焦虑的内心！
这算是我的性格里的bug了，总想急切的展示自己想要展示的一切，明知道真正厉害的人，从来都不着急。
赢家往往是沉得住气的人沉住气，沉下心不着急。
我不是，但我想是。
我真的好想大家就谈谈悬崖酒店的话题，大家不谈，我也很难插得上嘴。
怎么主动的掌控话题的主动权，做个甲方，是我要好好再回炉的命题，还是伪命题？
不知道紫萱是为了避开那个抽烟的家伙还是真的因为职业习惯或者真的是想看看悬崖酒店的现场，她触发了触发点的双数：“我们现在出发上山吧！
我想实地去看看。”
她的这番话让我有点惭愧，她只是个主持人啊，不是梦想者，都能这么主动，而我，一个差不多40岁号称要实现梦想的大男人，却在该主动出击的时候怂了包。
林凡，你要改，即便本性难移也要移，像江山易改那样的乾坤挪移本性，不然你就只能每个月尸位素餐般的生活着到退休，即便退休，按照现在延迟退休的年龄，也是要65才能退休了，还有25年，你是不是要做些改变？如三斤姐说的，是不是改改眉毛就可以转个运，我认真努力的改改性格就可以豪夺或者巧取自己想要的江山了。
邹家成面有难色：“餐厅今天接了个大旅游团的团餐，我走不开。”
紫萱说：“没有你，好像没有了指路明灯，不知道路该怎么走。
悬崖会不会很难爬上去？”
邹家成说：“哎，平凡哥来了好几次，平凡哥不平凡，他可以的。
我在餐厅准备你们的午饭。
你们下来之后就有饭吃了。”
紫萱看着我，问：“没问题吧？你的，带路。”
我正想为什么你们不提这事呢！

瞌睡时正好遇上个枕头，岂有不紧抱之理？心里一个机灵：“没问题，现在就出发。
也不远，穿过村子就是后山了。
既然矮仔成不去，我就班门弄斧重操旧业导游了。
走起！”
大家准备好便起身出发，邹家成走了过来：“等等，我还是叫一人和你们一起去吧！
我堂弟，邹家强。
喏，来了。”
他指了指门口朝我们走来的堂弟。
他的堂弟朝我们走了过来：“嗨，大家好，我是他堂弟，叫我小强就好了。”
说完指了指矮仔成。
小陈笑着说：“小强？你知道小强吗？”
小强满不在乎的说：“知道啊！
打不死的小强嘛！
我就是啊！
现在山上是吧？走！
哥，我带他们上山去。”
我说：“有地胆就是不同。”
确实如此，有个熟悉环境的人，没有那么的恐慌。
大家便一起穿过村子，朝山上进发。
content_en:
A group of people were chatting happily in Zou Jiacheng's restaurant. The conversation was not about the Cliff Hotel, but interesting things about the world. This is also the state I usually like, the state of drinking and meeting close friends, but at the same time, there is a touch point in my heart that seems to be triggered. This trigger point It's strange that it doesn't just trigger once to start, it seems to have to be triggered twice in a row to start. However, these guys talked about it like they just touched it once, and then ran away. After a while, someone came over, touched it twice, and then touched it once again, returning to zero.
The anxiety in my heart!
Why not touch even numbers? It's very similar to the mini bomb ballpoint pen in the hand of the dashing seven agent. The enemy pressed an odd number, and it was just a short press away from being triggered. It made me feel anxious!
This is a bug in my personality. I always want to show everything I want to show eagerly. People who know that they are really powerful are never in a hurry.
Winners are often those who can keep their composure and stay calm and not in a hurry.
I'm not, but I think so.
I really want everyone to talk about the Cliff Hotel. If everyone doesn’t talk about it, it’s hard for me to get involved.
How to take the initiative to control the topic and be a Party A? Is this a proposition that I want to revisit again, or is it a false proposition?
I don’t know whether Zixuan was trying to avoid the smoking guy or because of professional habits or because she really wanted to see the scene at the Cliff Hotel. She triggered the even number of trigger points: “Let’s go up the mountain now!
I want to see it in person. "
Her words made me feel a little ashamed. She was just a host, not a dreamer, yet she could be so proactive. But I, a nearly 40-year-old man who claims to realize his dream, was too timid when it was time to take the initiative.
Lin Fan, you have to change, even if your nature is hard to change, you have to change it, just like the nature of the world that is easy to change, otherwise you can only live like a corpse every month until retirement. Even if you retire, according to the current delayed retirement age, you will not be able to retire until 65. There are still 25 years left, do you want to make some changes? As Sister Sanjin said, if you change your eyebrows, you can change your luck. If I work hard to change my personality, I can seize or steal the country I want.
Zou Jiacheng looked troubled: "The restaurant received a group meal from a large tourist group today, and I can't leave."
Zixuan said: “Without you, it seems like there is no guiding light and I don’t know which way to go.
Will the cliff be difficult to climb? "
Zou Jiacheng said: "Hey, Brother Ordinary has been here several times, Brother Ordinary is extraordinary, he can do it.
I'll prepare your lunch in the restaurant.
You will have something to eat when you come down. "
Zixuan looked at me and asked, "Is it okay? It's yours, lead the way."
I was just wondering why you didn't mention this!
If you happen to find a pillow when you are dozing off, why not hug it tightly? A clever thought came to my mind: "No problem, let's go now.
It’s not far away either, passing through the village is the back mountain.
Since Gaozai can't go, I will try my best to return to my old job as a tour guide.
Let's go! "
When everyone was ready, they got up and set off. Zou Jiacheng came over and said, "Wait a minute, I'd better ask someone to go with you!"
My cousin, Zou Jiaqiang.
Well, here we come. "
He pointed to his cousin walking toward us at the door.
His cousin came over to us: "Hi, everyone, I am his cousin, just call me Xiaoqiang."
After speaking, he pointed at Aizi Cheng.
Xiao Chen smiled and said: "Xiao Qiang? Do you know Xiao Qiang?"
Xiaoqiang said nonchalantly: "I know!
The invincible Xiaoqiang!
That’s me!
It's on the mountain now, right? Go!
Brother, I'll take them up the mountain. "
I said: "Having earth gallbladder is different."
Indeed, there is someone who is familiar with the environment, so there is no such panic.
Everyone walked through the village together and headed towards the mountain.
